description: Buy a token with ETH: graduated tokens on Uniswap, or PONS tokens on their bonding curve. Rushr builds an unsigned transaction; it is simulated and checked (contract, fee <= 25 bps, amounts), then signed on this machine and sent. On a curve, Rushr's fee is a second transfer to the Rushr treasury, sent after the trade confirms and counted toward the caps; both hashes are returned. An overdue curve fee (fee_unpaid) is paid automatically up to 0.005 ETH. Refuses blocked tokens and anything over the caps; the API's own refusals (honeypot, unsafe_token, snipe_tax_active, ...) pass straight through. Caps: $10 per buy, $50 per 24h, size impact <= 300 bps, total impact <= 500 bps, 0.001 ETH kept for gas.

amountEth.description: ETH to spend instead of usd.

token.description: Token to buy with ETH: graduated (Uniswap) or a PONS token still on its bonding curve.

usd.description: USD value to spend. Capped by RUSHR_MAX_TRADE_USD and RUSHR_DAILY_USD.
